svg.text: Foundry ontology engine — complete data structures
Every field exists to handle a specific failure mode. Failure mode noted on each.
1 ClassNode
The fundamental unit. One node per object type in the world.

g.text: stable identity if name is renamed
#9 cascade corruption — walk this to find affected children
#10 source death — which connectors feed this class
#7 ghost class — active | quarantine | deprecated | ghost
#7 ghost class — below threshold = candidate for ghost
when this class was first inferred
#11 version explosion — increments on structural changes only
#7 ghost class — human-defined classes get extra protection

svg.text: 2 PropertyDescriptor
Attached to ClassNode. The most complex structure — handles 7 of the 11 failure modes.

g.text: stable identity even if name changes
original field name from source exactly
int | float | string | bool | datetime | object | array | null
#1 type conflict — full log of every type ever seen + timestamp
#1 type conflict — clean | soft_conflict | hard_conflict | resolved
#1 type conflict — coerce | union_type | quarantine | promote
#6 structural change — scalar | nested_object | array | mixed
#6 structural change — was scalar, became object on date X
if true, field is stored raw without inference (safe fallback)
#5 null flooding — above 0.95 moves to low-confidence tier
how often this field appears in records of this class
rule | tiny_model | llm | human — which tier resolved this
spatial pairs — lat linked to lon, always updated together
#10 source death — which connector introduced this property
#2 field disappearance — alert if gap exceeds threshold
#2 field disappearance — times this field went missing then returned

svg.text: ↳ TypeRecord (element of type_history list)

g.text: first_observed DateTime when this type first appeared
last_observed DateTime when this type was last seen
sample_value String one representative raw value for debugging
occurrence_count Int how many times this type was seen

svg.text: 3 RelationshipEdge
Neo4j edge between ClassNodes. Handles circular traversal and cascade corruption.

g.text: #8 circular relationship — hard cap on query traversal depth
#8 circular — if true, query engine checks for cycle before traversal
#9 cascade — if false, parent schema changes do NOT auto-push to children
auto-detected edges start at 0.5, human-confirmed at 1.0
false = human defined, protected from auto-deletion
how many real instances of this relationship have been observed
active | candidate | deprecated — candidate needs human confirmation

svg.text: 4 ConnectorRecord
Tracks every data source. Critical for #10 source death — every fact in the graph
traces back to a connector. If the connector dies, its data is flagged stale.

g.text: #10 source death — alive | degraded | dead | paused
#10 — after this gap, all data from connector is flagged stale
hash of last seen field list — change = schema drift alert
full log of every schema change this connector has made
throughput baseline — sudden drop = degraded status

svg.text: 5 OntologyChangeEvent
Written to an append-only log on EVERY schema mutation. NOT a versioned snapshot.
Fixes #11 version explosion — granular events instead of full snapshots per change.

g.text: info | warning | critical — type conflict = critical
snapshot of entity before the change
snapshot of entity after the change
if true, this change was reverted — keeps audit trail intact

svg.text: 6 FingerprintResult
Pipeline output per field per record. Ephemeral — not stored in graph, used to decide
what to write. Think of this as the message on the conveyor belt before it hits the graph.

g.text: one raw value for type inference
#5 null flooding — counted before any inference runs
classifier output — "unknown" if no tier resolves it
#1 type conflict — true if type differs from stored current_type
write | rescue | flag | discard — final decision for this field
rule | tiny_model | llm — which tier resolved, for latency audit

svg.text: 7 ClassBoundaryDecision
Written whenever the engine decides to extend vs create for a new object.
Handles #4 class boundary ambiguity — the decision and its reasoning are stored.

g.text: the fields that triggered this decision
#4 ambiguity — overlap % against every existing class
which class was extended or merged (null if create_new)
below 0.6 = automatically queued for human review
false = system decision, true = human confirmed or overridden
if human overrode the system decision, why
